preconditions.description: The input contains exactly N+1 lines: the first line is N, followed by N lines representing the matrix rows.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 100 for x in all_cells)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the matrix contains an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The matrix size N is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row.split()) == N for row in matrix_lines)
preconditions.description: Each of the N matrix lines contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.description: The output is the total count of all valid decreasing paths in the matrix modulo 10^9+7.

postconditions.expression: total_decreasing_paths == sum(count_paths(r, c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N))
postconditions.description: The total count is the sum of the number of valid decreasing paths starting from each cell (r, c) in the matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(is_valid_path(p, matrix) for p in all_paths)
postconditions.description: Every path counted is a valid decreasing path: it starts at some cell, each subsequent cell is adjacent (up/down/left/right), within bounds, and strictly smaller than the previous cell.
